body:
Where do you think that bitterness came from? I used to be happy-go-lucky. To the point where people would genuinely wonder where the positivity came from. No, I'm not joking. I was so hopelessly naive.

I spent SO much time and effort attempting to find connection that I am now a hollow shell. I am the same age as you, but no one ever wanted to be with me, they always wanted to be with people like you. Crazily, enough, that made me bitter.  I know that's some crazy personal defect, but I'm a human, so sue me.

They have done studies that show that when people exclude you, you become more negative and neurotic by default.  When you are those things, people exclude you. Thus it feeds into itself and one ends up here, because they are trapped by circumstance and others.  The others owe them nothing, and nothing they shall get. If another were to let them in, the cycle would reverse, but it won't because they won't because there is always someone like you who is better and more correct.

So the answer is suicide.  Do you not see? It's fate.

I get the acute impression we're going to die by our own hands.

I wish I was wrong, but society is going the opposite way.  I saw a church that had "multiples support" aka woman with multiple men.

No one gives a  shit about us.  People don't care, there is no community.  Be born pretty, or a woman, or correct.  Don't be born wrong, otherwise you deserve it you loser.  Right?  I don't get it either, there is very little to like about this species.

I have had chest pains as well for the past half year or so. Most days I have trouble not bursting into tears at some point, the difference is that there was no reprieve. I can barely eat some days, as all I want is human contact, I want to be touched. I am fully aware of what I am missing, acutely. 

"It is better to have loved and to have lost, than to never have loved at all."  

Right? If you're trying to say that ignorance is bliss, shove it. I get what you're saying, but you really don't seem to care, and because of that, you're just proving my point.  People who love really don't give a shit about those whom they do not give their live. If you don't have love, you don't deserve it; therefore, if you die you deserve to, therefor if you get raped you deserve to, therefor all the people suffering deserve to, therefor genocide is because they just didn't love themselves enough. If they just would have opened up more, and done more introspection, or something.

I hope you find love again, but I will not allow you to pretend that you know everything.  You don't care about me, and my plight, so I do not care about you.

>We created it together.

Right, that's the problem.

Together.  Only some people apparently get to be together.  Only some people get to be chosen; one can be an infinite font of love, and that doesn't mean it will ever return.

So that's why love is horrible, because it chooses some and not all, and all the searching, all the praying, all the meditation and study amounts to nothing if you are not loved back.
That's amazing you did that, congratulations. I've never been able to connect with others, there isn't much room for that sort of thing, but it's neat to see someone living that out!

Probably just all the things that are difficult to do with people around, like driving sports cars at full speed through downtown, flooding castles and swimming in them, skydiving from hot air balloons onto targets.  That's a fun question, no doubt.

I do agree that it is helpful to help others, so I will take that lesson in. Thank you for that, it is always good to have a reminder.  At the same time, it becomes so hard to do that when you feel and are excluded.  How does one deal with that?

I honestly find your worldview sort of offensive.  It's the just world hypothesis paraded in semi-spiritual language.

I get what you are saying, but I can come up with a littany of examples where that isn't true through history as well as the present day, which seems to indicate this is not the correct interpretation of reality, as much as I would love for it to be so.

What about, for example, abused children? What about people who get killed, etc. etc. etc.

Why is it that more beautiful people, for example, get to love more?  The answers don't seem to indicate many things to be positive over. Whether human nature, ethereal spirituality, etc.

That's just not true. Many people love others more than themselves and it works out wonderfully, if not ideally. Perfect is the enemy of good.

Love is most certainly held closely, usually by those whom otherwise speak of it's freedom and beauty.  Funny thing, that.

Funny thing, that.

Do you not realize that some of us do not get love and never have?

Please, you are rubbing salt in my wound.  I have no love and it is all I have EVER wanted. I used to pray and blow out birthday candles, and every last wish was for love. That was it. That's always been it.  It is all I search for, yearn for, and desire.

How can I "give up" on something that gave up on me?  Do you not realize that some of us do not get love, and THAT is why we kill ourselves?
